//engines: sharp, used by the prebuild step that renders OG images, needs Node >= 20.9.0. Pinned explicitly so Vercel does not pick a default older than that — package.json engines is a hint, this is the authoritative setting for the build.
//rewrites: SPA fallback for client-side routes. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so the static pages written by scripts/prerender.mjs (e.g. /listings/osm-n3c45x/index.html) are served as pre-rendered HTML; this rule only catches the routes that have no static file. The negative lookahead is essential: without it /(.*) also matches /api/*, so every API call returned index.html and the browser failed with "Unexpected token '<' ... is not valid JSON".

headers.//: Never cache the API. A stale listings response is worse than an error: it shows someone a shop that has already closed.
Open Graph images are content-addressed by name (og/listing-<id>.png), so they can be cached hard. A slow share preview is a certain problem; a stale card for a renamed listing is a minor one.
